claims.text: Atlas processes a cross-organization unlink when the next invoice is generated. The paying organization continues to incur the linked organization's charges for the current invoice period; the detached organization receives separate invoices afterward. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30)

MongoDB directs customers to support when they want to unlink all organizations from a paying organization and link them into another cross-organization configuration. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30)

Vantage's 1 February 2023 integration announcement says it accepts multiple Atlas organization integrations and removes the associated organization's costs from its console when an integration is removed. This historical behavior is a reason to verify retention before removing a FinOps connection during unlinking; it does not describe Atlas unlinking itself. (low confidence) (verified as of 2023-02-01)

Before unlinking, Atlas linked organizations use the paying organization's subscription agreement, including support level, subscription charges, discounts, and payment terms. LICENSEWARE repeats this rule from MongoDB rather than providing independent confirmation of it. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30)

In the Atlas UI, open Billing > Linked Organizations, click Unlink beside the organization, and save a new payment method. The unlink procedure accepts a credit card number or MongoDB activation code. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30)

The operator needs permission to change the linked organization's billing settings. Atlas identifies Organization Owner and Organization Billing Admin as the roles that can configure billing settings. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30)

Before the next invoice is processed, Cancel Unlinking on the Linked Organizations tab cancels the pending request. An activation code applied during the request can then be applied to the paying organization or removed for use elsewhere. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30)
MongoDB's 30 May 2024 Atlas release added the ability to unlink organizations from a paying organization through the Atlas UI. (low confidence)

Cloudaware documents a separate organization ID for each Atlas organization it ingests, organization-level billing access, and reconciliation against Atlas Billing and Invoices for the same organization and month. It also asks operators to check that linked-organization invoices appear. These checks provide a cutover verification method after unlinking; the guide does not establish automatic migration of a billing integration. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-28)
